text: Managing a team is a skill that takes time to develop. First, clear communication is essential, so everyone understands their tasks and goals. Good managers also learn delegation, trusting team members with responsibilities instead of doing everything alone. Giving regular feedback helps people improve and feel valued, which increases motivation. When disagreements happen, a manager should stay calm and listen to both sides to find a fair solution. By combining these skills, you can build a strong, happy team that works well together and achieves great results.
